review_findings.finding: Empty notification subject for terminal-mode sessions
review_findings.change: Use SessionPreview.agentName(), including its Agent fallback. Existing notifier test now checks the empty harness case.

review_findings.finding: Wheel remainder crosses primary and alternate screen units
review_findings.change: Reset wheel and pixel remainders on mode or document changes. Protocol fixture covers both transitions with partial deltas and verifies complete rows/notches still reach the target.
review_findings.before: The new background regression failed with A partial wheel angle crossed screen modes.

review_findings.finding: Malformed live snapshots close SSE without a status event
review_findings.change: Catch GatewayError across snapshot acceptance, rendering and history delivery, then emit disconnected status.
review_findings.before: All three malformed-stream subcases raised an uncaught GatewayError.
review_findings.after: Invalid flags, truncated header and malformed cell payload retain the initial frame and emit one disconnected status.

review_findings.evidence: add_link is private; terminal_link_at, joined_rows and covered produce cell spans within the validated snapshot grid. No external span input or reachable invalid-column producer was identified.

review_findings.finding: Queued frame callback after receiver destruction
review_findings.evidence: The connection uses this as its QObject context. A local Qt 6.11.2 QCoreApplication probe queued the same signal to live and deleted receivers, then processed posted events: live_callbacks=1, destroyed_callbacks=0. No GUI opened.

review_findings.finding: Reset output throttle on every publication
review_findings.evidence: frameInterval explicitly bounds redraws caused by output; since_frame_ records the last throttled frame. Most cited geometry/font/link/IME publications use publishFrame(false) and deliberately retain the output timing reference. No scheduling change was retained.

checks.ios: testTakenElsewhereThenReopened and testSyncedWithTheMac passed in the headless simulator; Mac client stayed attached and saw phone input

visual_review: Inspected the captured history view: row text, full-height scrubber and Live action are present and within the terminal geometry.
integration: Merged background review tooling from PR18, preserving PR19 history UI tests. Resolved the shared test entry-point conflict before the passing assembled run.
reuse: Native GPU/IME, sanitizer, service and other iPhone evidence remain at their original revisions in pr19-review-repairs.json. No native desktop focus or pointer injection was used for this follow-up.
artifacts: Per-run logs, JSON and 30 software PNGs under build/reports/ui-review/; no second fixture launch is needed for visual review.
